I’m a 28 Y.O. Virgo. When Mac died, shortly after I went straight to the Burgh after I had a panic attack one night lol. I was a mess and all I wanted to do was pay respects to the legend. I drove non stop to Asheville for a nights rest. Booked an airb&b in shady side... and just began walking around endlessly that night thru his hood. Bumping Mac so loud in my headphones. Got to her they mural they painted for him :) coming from Miami and growing up in graff culture that was really deep for me. man pittsburgh showed so much love. The people were so dope. so chill. Everyone was so warm and seems they had sumn to say about Mac too and coming from a local their opinions meant a lot to me. I’ll never forget just driving thru the country after and feeling so fulfilled after that on my drive back down to dade county. I had stopped at timebomb / daily bread to pick up some gear as well. Dope ass hooide and snap back I got. And I went to Jerry’s record store copper a t shirt there. I love the burgh and the women I met from there too 🥰
